codeReview.summary: The deletion of agent_host/ and worker/ is complete and correct. All 15 deleted files are accounted for. All import sites were updated to use the new local paths in api/routers/ws/. The migration faithfully preserves the original terminal event ordering semantics (persist → complete_run → send for final events; send → persist → complete_run for cancelled/error). The new stream_agent_turn() async generator correctly replaces stream_hosted_workspace_task(), and ReplHookBridge lifecycle (start/stop in try/finally) is properly managed in both stream.py and turn_runner.py. The HITL stub correctly returns False for all inputs. One non-blocking type annotation imprecision: stream_agent_turn is declared to return AsyncIterator[WorkspaceEvent] but is a generator function (uses yield), which should strictly be AsyncGenerator[WorkspaceEvent, None]. In practice both are structurally equivalent and the type checker accepted it.

issues.description: stream_agent_turn uses yield (making it an async generator function) but is annotated with return type AsyncIterator[WorkspaceEvent]. Technically should be AsyncGenerator[WorkspaceEvent, None]. No runtime impact, but slightly imprecise. Did not cause a typecheck failure because AsyncGenerator is structurally compatible with AsyncIterator.

At commit 6cec4a48, src/fleet_rlm/AGENTS.md still referenced the deleted agent_host/ and worker/ directories (lines 50, 135, 137). Root AGENTS.md also had stale references. These were corrected in the follow-up commit 8916178f. The feature description did not explicitly require AGENTS.md updates, and make test/lint/typecheck all pass, but the docs were left inconsistent for one commit.

summary: Pass. All agent_host/ and worker/ directories are deleted, all dangling imports fixed, and the new ws/ local implementations (types.py dataclasses, repl_bridge.py, startup_status.py, inlined terminal.py policy) correctly replicate the original behavior without HITL/checkpoint logic. All 1140 tests pass, lint clean, typecheck clean. Two non-blocking findings: (1) stream_agent_turn return type annotation uses AsyncIterator instead of AsyncGenerator — cosmetically imprecise but functionally correct; (2) AGENTS.md documentation was left stale at this commit (both root and src/fleet_rlm/AGENTS.md still referenced deleted directories) and was only corrected in the next commit 8916178f.
